title: 第11章 王老变年轻了第12章 奇妙的字画
slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
“嘉庆，给他们再泡壶茶。”郁凡站在二楼的栏杆处垂视着楼下的人。
听到郁凡的声音，王老示意王景焕将他扶起来。
然而两人才站起身来，便看到了已经坐在沙发对面的郁凡。
他们震惊的瞪大了眼睛，朝楼上望去。
这么快？从楼上栏杆处到楼下的客厅走下来，至少得花上好几分钟，可这人却在这一瞬间便出现在这儿。
简直太诡异了。
王老还算是见识广，很快便回过神来，更是忌惮，对着郁凡深深的鞠了一躬：“郁先生，您好，今日前来，主要是为了感谢您对我的救命之恩。”
他示意王景焕将带来的礼物拿了出来。
因为清楚郁凡的真实年龄，知道自己送的东西人家不见得看得上，只能尽量的拿出自己最好的收藏品。
一幅价值3亿的古代著名书法家唐渊的真迹，可算的上是王老的心头好了。
王景焕连忙将手中的被妥善保存的书画和用陶瓷罐装好的大红袍放在桌子上。
郁凡扫了一眼，从那幅字画里隐约可以看到一丝灵气，想来价值应该是不低的。
他根据前段时间自己典当的物件得出来的结论，猜测蓝星上有些东西具有一丝灵气，那些东西的价值相对会比普通物件要高。
就好比古董就是比其他东西值钱一样。
看到王景焕拿出来的大红袍，想到自己刚才喝的茶，王老有些羞愧，自家这当宝贝一样只差没贡起来的茶，在这人的眼中可能一文不值。
“随手为之，不必太过于放在心上。”郁凡不在意的说。
王老正色道：“您虽然是随手为之，可却救了我的命，如果不是您，或许我就死了。”
不是或许，是一定会死。郁凡暗自想着。
“我叫王德佑，海市王氏电子科技现任董事长，您有任何需要可以随时来找我。”
不得不说王德佑的聪明，告知对方自己的信息，并点明自己在海市的影响力。

郁嘉庆惊呼了一声：“王德佑，海市的电子产业巨头！”天，这可是上了华国福瑞斯排行榜的人。
他没想到有一天居然能看到真人！
郁凡看着郁嘉庆一脸惊讶崇拜的看着王德佑的表情，便知道这人的身份不简单了。
“呵呵，只是开了一家电子公司，我也没有多大的本事。”王德佑谦虚的说。
郁嘉庆不由觉得这老人家也是凡尔赛了，这叫只是一家电子公司吗？能成为电子产业的领军人物，能和漂亮国打擂台赛的公司那可不是一般的小公司了。
郁凡不懂电子公司是什么，想来也是一个比较厉害的公司了。
考虑到郁嘉庆的一些想法，他觉得或许这个人可以用上一用，毕竟他现在手头正是没人可用之际。
“我想和你谈笔交易。”郁凡不想跟人拐弯抹角，直接道。
听到这话，王德佑有些惊讶，他原本只是想试探着能不能搭上郁凡这个神医的线，没想到对方居然直接找他谈交易。
两人转移至书房谈话，留下在外面大眼瞪小眼的郁嘉庆和王景焕。
郁嘉庆不得不说是个机灵的人，他连忙给王景焕泡上一壶茶，两人酣聊了起来。
两人都有意去结交，很快便称兄道弟了起来。
content_en:
"Jiaqing, make them another pot of tea." Yu Fan stood at the railing on the second floor and looked down at the people downstairs.
Hearing Yu Fan's voice, Mr. Wang motioned to Wang Jinghuan to help him up.
However, the two of them stood up and saw Yu Fan, who was already sitting across from the sofa.
Their eyes widened in shock and they looked upstairs.
So fast? It would take at least several minutes to walk from the railing upstairs to the living room downstairs, but this person appeared here at this moment.
It's just too weird.
Mr. Wang was quite knowledgeable and quickly came to his senses. He was even more worried and bowed deeply to Yu Fan: "Hello, Mr. Yu. I came here today mainly to thank you for saving my life."
He motioned to Wang Jinghuan to take out the gifts he had brought.
Because he knew Yu Fan's true age and knew that others might not appreciate the things he gave him, he could only try his best to bring out his best collection.
An authentic work by Tang Yuan, a famous ancient calligrapher worth 300 million yuan, is considered to be Mr. Wang's favorite.
Wang Jinghuan quickly placed the well-preserved calligraphy and painting in his hand and the Dahongpao in a ceramic jar on the table.
Yu Fan glanced at it and could vaguely see a hint of aura from the calligraphy and painting. It must be of high value.
Based on the conclusions he drew from the objects he pawned some time ago, he guessed that some things on Blue Star had a hint of aura, and the value of those things would be relatively higher than ordinary objects.
Just like antiques are more valuable than other things.
Seeing the big red robe that Wang Jinghuan took out, Mr. Wang felt a little ashamed when he thought about the tea he had just drank. The tea that he regarded as a treasure but only missed the tribute might be worthless in this man's eyes.
"Just do it casually, don't take it too seriously." Yu Fan said nonchalantly.
Mr. Wang said seriously: "Although you did it casually, you saved my life. If it weren't for you, maybe I would have died."
Not maybe, but definitely dead. Yu Fan thought to himself.
"My name is Wang Deyou, the current chairman of Haishi Wangshi Electronic Technology. If you need anything, you can come to me at any time."
I have to say that Wang Deyou was smart, informing the other party of his information and pointing out his influence in Haishi.
Yu Jiaqing exclaimed: "Wang Deyou, the electronics industry giant in Haishi!" Oh my god, this is someone who is on the Chinese Forrest rankings.
He didn't expect that one day he would be able to see a real person!
Yu Fan looked at Yu Jiaqing's expression of surprise and admiration as he looked at Wang Deyou, and knew that this person's identity was not simple.
"Haha, I just opened an electronics company, and I don't have much ability." Wang Deyou said modestly.
Yu Jiaqing couldn't help but feel that this old man was also in Versailles. Is this just an electronics company? A company that can become a leader in the electronics industry and compete with the beautiful country is no ordinary small company.
Yu Fan didn't know what an electronics company was, but he thought it was a pretty powerful company.
Taking into account some of Yu Jiaqing's ideas, he felt that maybe this person could be put to use. After all, he had no one available at the moment.
"I want to negotiate a deal with you." Yu Fan said directly, not wanting to beat around the bush.
Hearing this, Wang Deyou was a little surprised. He originally just wanted to test whether he could get in touch with Yu Fan, the miracle doctor, but he didn't expect that the other party actually approached him directly to negotiate a deal.
The two moved to the study to talk, leaving Yu Jiaqing and Wang Jinghuan staring outside.
Yu Jiaqing had to be said to be a smart person. He quickly made Wang Jinghuan a pot of tea, and the two started chatting.
Both of them were interested in making friends, and soon they became brothers.
